overloadMerges.note: The doc syntax line has no parenthesized parameter list ('Level : Integer'), so the mechanical parser produced an empty overload with no return type at all; added the documented Integer return type.
overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns the current header or break level, valid during the On Header and On Printing Break form events.

constraints: Level 0 is the last level printed, used for a grand total; Level returns 1 on a break on the first sorted field, 2 on the second, and so on.
